title: Output Contract + Error Infrastructure + Global Settings
description: Implement the JSON output contract, the IOutputWriter abstraction, CliqCliException, GlobalSettings, and the Spectre.Console CommandApp with its global exception handler. This establishes the complete I/O skeleton that every subsequent command will depend on.
prerequisiteState: Story 1 complete. Three projects compile. IKeychainProvider and all implementations exist. Program.cs stub exists.
goal: Produce a functional cliq-cli binary that correctly routes all output through IOutputWriter, converts exceptions to the JSON error envelope on stderr, and handles --help and --version with the correct exit codes.
scope: Add Spectre.Console.Cli NuGet reference to CliqCli.csproj
Add Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection to CliqCli.csproj and CliqCli.Core.csproj
Create src/CliqCli.Core/IOutputWriter.cs with WriteSuccess(object data) and WriteError(string message, string code, int exitCode)

Create src/CliqCli.Core/JsonOutputWriter.cs implementing IOutputWriter — writes { "status": "ok", "data": ... } to stdout and { "error": ..., "code": ..., "exitCode": ... } to stderr using System.Text.Json with SnakeCaseLower naming policy
Create src/CliqCli.Core/InMemoryOutputWriter.cs for tests — captures written output in List<string> properties for assertion
Create src/CliqCli.Core/CliqCliException.cs with string Code and int ExitCode properties

Create src/CliqCli.Core/ErrorCodes.cs with all symbolic constants (ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND, ACCOUNT_ALREADY_EXISTS, NO_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, AUTH_FAILURE, NEEDS_REAUTH, API_ERROR, INVALID_ARGS, IO_ERROR, KEYCHAIN_ERROR, ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED, HOST_NOT_ALLOWED, NOT_IMPLEMENTED)
Create src/CliqCli/Commands/GlobalSettings.cs inheriting CommandSettings with --account, --json (default true), --no-input properties

Update src/CliqCli/Program.cs: create IServiceCollection, register JsonOutputWriter as IOutputWriter singleton, register IKeychainProvider via KeychainProviderFactory, build CommandApp with ITypeRegistrar bridging MEDI, wire SetExceptionHandler to convert CliqCliException and unhandled Exception to JSON error envelope on stderr
Ensure Ctrl+C (CancellationTokenSource) triggers exit code 1 with no output

Write unit tests in CliqCli.Tests verifying: WriteSuccess produces correct JSON on stdout; WriteError produces correct envelope on stderr; CliqCliException is correctly serialized by the global exception handler
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
cliq-cli --version prints the version and exits 0
cliq-cli --help prints top-level help and exits 0
An unhandled CliqCliException produces { "error": "...", "code": "...", "exitCode": 1 } on stderr and exits with the code's exit code
An unhandled generic Exception produces { "error": "...", "code": "INTERNAL_ERROR", "exitCode": 1 } on stderr
IOutputWriter is registered in DI and injected into command classes via constructor
JsonOutputWriter uses JsonNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower for all serialized output
InMemoryOutputWriter is available in CliqCli.Tests for use by all future test stories
Token values do not appear in any output path (verified by code inspection — no Console.Write outside IOutputWriter)
contextForAgent: Read ADR-0004 for the full output contract design including the IOutputWriter rationale. Read ADR-0002 for the Spectre.Console.Cli DI registrar pattern — specifically the ITypeRegistrar bridge to MEDI and the SetExceptionHandler hook. The error envelope has an optional 'detail' field for API_ERROR only (see OQ-007). The --json flag defaults to true in v1; plain-text output is not supported. All command settings classes must inherit GlobalSettings.

openItems.defaultAssumption: See OQ-007. Only API_ERROR uses 'detail'. All other error codes omit it. JsonOutputWriter should support an optional detail parameter on WriteError.
Add Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Console registered at Warning level by default. Log to stderr only. Do not emit log lines that could break the JSON output contract on stdout.
